about: Which software licences a Forge bundle may carry. release/licence_check.py reads each package's licence text and sorts it: review first (needs a person's look), then deny (copyleft that would bind a paid Forge, and the Commons Clause, which forbids selling), then allow. Patterns are fnmatch, case-insensitive, on one licence option; 'A or B' passes when any option is allowed, 'A and B' only when every part is. exceptions names packages whose deny is known and accepted for now, with the reason. build.py runs it on the packages each bundle really holds (a deny with no exception stops the build), and build.py --check-only runs licence_check.py --deny on the apps' own venvs.

exceptions.pymupdf: InkForge's PDF reader: AGPL-3.0 or Artifex's paid licence. Accepted for the free 0.1 builds only; the owner decides (swap library, ship InkForge AGPL, or buy the licence) before any paid edition.
exceptions.pyphen: WeasyPrint's hyphenation (Office's PDF export). Tri-licensed GPLv2+, LGPLv2.1+ or MPL-1.1; Forge takes it under MPL-1.1 (file-level copyleft, unchanged files). Relay task 382.
exceptions.tld: Shelf's address parsing (through trafilatura and courlan). Tri-licensed MPL-1.1, GPLv2 or LGPLv2.1+; Forge takes it under MPL-1.1 like pyphen (unchanged files). Relay task 452.
exceptions.justext: Shelf's boilerplate remover (through trafilatura): BSD 2-Clause; its metadata words it 'The BSD 2-Clause License', which the allow patterns miss. Relay task 452.
exceptions.python-dateutil: Date parsing (Shelf, through trafilatura): dual Apache-2.0 or BSD-3-Clause, both allowed; its metadata says only 'Dual License'. Relay task 452.
exceptions.regex: Pattern matching (Shelf, through dateparser): Apache-2.0 with CNRI-Python parts taken from CPython, both permissive. Relay task 452.
